title: Duality preserves decision tree depth
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $f:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\{−1,1\}$. Define its dual by $f^*(x)=-f(\mathbf{1}-x)$, with subtraction taken coordinatewise in $\mathbb{F}_2^n$. Then the minimum depth of a binary decision tree computing $f^*$ equals the minimum depth of a binary decision tree computing $f$.
